case.summary: Case HHG-001 was opened following a risk score trigger of 0.61 on transaction 3514030 ($77.07) for customer C12382 on card C12382-K1. Although the closed-case classifier scored the transaction at 0.79 and the customer had four earlier confirmed fraud cases (CC-1066, CC-2964, CC-3587, CC-1673), historical card-present purchase patterns in billing region 444.0 and continuing home region activity indicated a legitimate trip rather than a clone. Graph analysis assigned a fraud probability of 0.15 with a legitimate verdict under pattern none. Per Policy R3 and §0/§6, the final action is CLOSE_NO_FRAUD.
